html:
Hey there stranger. I’m a thinker, I like to figure things out, and you?
I studied cybersecurity and computer science and am all into things emerging from chaos. Been to Asia a few times.

I’m addicted to learning, and the only updated version of this brainsite is me.

I’d rather talk via signal. Whatsapp tracks your metadata and saves backups unencrypted by default on google… And for instagram: why I deleted my social media accounts. I’m assuming that if you found this site, you can find me.
